value.rationale: The object is the natural unit-transfer graph arising from loss of one occurrence in a five-symbol, length-five unordered channel. The previous maximum cardinality 26 leaves structural equality cases unresolved. Counting and classifying every optimum shows complete checksum rigidity, a unique S5-orbit with affine stabilizer, and perfection of every maximum. This is a motivated full finite classification with a reproducible exact proof; no coding rate gain is inferred.
